appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Preferred Mode of Transport in Region R'.
Legend shows red color corresponds to 'Car' and gray color corresponds to 'Public Transit'.
Red slice occupies 42% of the pie chart area and is labeled '42%'.
Gray slice occupies 58% of the pie chart area and is labeled '58%'.

public_definitions: Review the Region R transport preference dashboard, then choose the transport mode that should enter majority-preference policy follow-up.
